description: Searches the TakeJournal guide (how to use the app: imports, connections, the journal, prop accounts and firm rules, analytics, copies, plans and data). Returns the best matching sections with their text and URL. The guide is written in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German and French, each reader's in theirs: search in the language the user writes in when it is one of these, else in English; a search that finds nothing there reads the English guide.

query.description: Words to look for, in the user's language

name: search_guide
